ideas.pitch: An offline AI code reviewer optimized for Snapdragon NPUs that runs real-time security and lint checks directly on edge hardware.
ideas.title: Jarvis-Ops: Autonomous Edge AI Code Reviewer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Aligns with the J.A.R.V.I.S. theme of intelligent automation and mirrors a proven winning pattern of building hardware-adjacent, offline developer tooling.

ideas.pitch: A visual BPMN-orchestrated workflow debugger that automatically checks multi-agent AI pipelines for compliance and runtime safety hazards.
ideas.title: BPMN-Shield: Pre-Deployment Risk Diagnosis for AI Workflows
ideas.why_it_could_win: Judges at industry-focused hackathons prioritize enterprise risk mitigation and governance over standard chat interfaces.

ideas.pitch: A lightning-fast semantic router using kNN over an exemplar index that dynamically routes incoming queries to optimal models while cutting API costs.
ideas.title: SemanticRoute: Training-Free Self-Improving LLM Gateway
ideas.why_it_could_win: Demonstrates genuine systems-level engineering and optimization, which stands out in a field of generic wrappers.

ideas.pitch: An anti-money laundering investigation platform that combines graph intelligence with explainable machine learning for real-time transaction anomaly detection.
ideas.title: GraphAML: AWS-Powered AML Risk Detection
ideas.why_it_could_win: Applies advanced data structures (graphs) to a high-value industry use case, impressing judges looking for real-world relevance.

ideas.pitch: A zero-knowledge gated collaboration space where verified human operators and autonomous AI agents can share private insights securely.
ideas.title: ZK-Sentinel: Gated Community Platform for Verified AI Agents
ideas.why_it_could_win: Tackles cutting-edge cryptographic concepts combined with multi-agent systems, showcasing high technical ambition within a tight timeline.
